title: One Live Case, Award Frequency and Reapplication After Denial: Patient Financial Assistance Program
content:
**The rule.** Under the Patient Financial Assistance Program a patient may have only one live case, meaning a case whose status is submitted, pending documents, under review or approved, with a single exception: a renewal application may be submitted while an award is approved, but only within the tier's renewal window of calendar days before that award's end date. A new application while another live case exists is not opened; the patient is told the status of the existing case.

**Award frequency.** A patient may receive at most the tier's number of approved cases with decision dates within any 365 days. The count for a decision takes the 365 calendar days before that decision date, the decision date included, and counts the patient's cases in approved, expired or rescinded status whose decision date falls in that span.

**Reapplying after a denial.** After a denial for income above the program limit, a new application is accepted only after the tier's reapplication wait of calendar days, unless the patient states that household income or household size has changed. After a denial for missing documents, a new application may be made at once.

**Evidence.** Whether a live case exists is read from the patient's own assistance cases on file (their status, and for an approved award its end date), not from the patient's account of them.

## Statuses at a glance

| Status of the patient's existing case | Counts as live |
|---|---|
| Submitted | Yes |
| Pending documents | Yes |
| Under review | Yes |
| Approved | Yes |
| Denied, withdrawn, expired, rescinded | No |

## Points of judgement

- **A case is under review and the patient asks to apply again.** The new application is not opened; the patient is told the status of the case under review.
- **An award is approved and the patient applies for a renewal inside the renewal window before the award's end date.** The renewal application may be submitted.
- **An award is approved and the patient asks to apply before the renewal window opens.** The application is not opened; the patient is told the status of the approved award.
- **A case was denied for missing documents last week.** A new application may be made at once.
- **A case was denied for income above the program limit, the reapplication wait has not run, and the patient states that household size has grown since.** The new application is accepted, because the patient states a change of household size.

## Illustration of the frequency count (hypothetical dates)

A patient's tier allows 2 approved cases within any 365 days. Cases with decision dates of 10 February and 1 September of one year are on file in approved or expired status. A decision dated 5 January of the following year looks back over the 365 calendar days ending on 5 January; both earlier decisions fall in that span, so the count already stands at 2.
